selection: 10 predefined records with distinct meeting IDs and transcription length between 1500 and 3500 characters
limitations: Length-constrained convenience sample from the project corpus, not a random or independent test set.
No human ground truth is available for these transcriptions; label and product counts do not measure accuracy.
Product candidates come only from knowledge base documents with document_type=produto; similarity scores do not confirm product fit.
Complete results with original transcriptions and meeting IDs are stored locally in ignored data/processed/analises_finais_10.json.
